Checks the inbox every 5 minutes for unread emails with attachments. Expects exactly 2 files:
- an Excel template (with “projektcontrolling”/“template”/“mto” in the name)
and
- an actual time-tracking report as a CSV file (with “elts”/‘zeiterfassung’/“cn” in the name).

Throws an error if either of the two is missing.

Uploads the template to OneDrive and dynamically reads the number of consultant rows. All required Excel ranges (months, names, PLAN rows, ACTUAL rows, total row) are automatically generated from this data.
Batch retrieval of all ranges, followed by conversion into structured JSON objects for each person, including planned and actual values for each month.

At the same time: The uploaded time-tracking CSV file is imported, hours per person per month are totaled, and converted to person-days (PD = hours/8).
⚠️ Expect a comma as the decimal separator (e.g., “1,00”) and the date format DD.MM.YYYY.

Combines all three sources (Template-PLAN, Template-ACTUAL, CSV-ACTUAL) and matches names (full name, last name only, first name only, and also “Name1 / Name2”).

Calculates the deviation between PLAN and IST, including traffic-light logic (🟢 <5% / 🟡 <15% / 🔴 ≥15%), only for the currently reported month.

Returns each calculated cell individually via the Graph API (batch loop).
Writes the formula only if it is missing from the template or is incorrect.

Reads the separate sheet “ Cumulative Basis (Kumulgrundlage)”, checks whether the current month already exists, and whether the cumulative values (previous year's total + new month) are correct.
Uses an Excel workbook session to write the month headers and cumulative values atomically (create a new column OR correct an existing one).

Generates the text summary (monthly & cumulative traffic light), re-downloads the updated template from OneDrive, collects all errors from previous nodes (those running with `continueErrorOutput`), and attaches them to the reply email. Sends it as a reply to the original sender and marks the original email as read.

nodes.name: Enter Actual "IST" Values in the Template

parameters.content:
## Update a project controlling Excel template from timesheet CSV emails with Outlook and OneDrive

Send an email with an Excel template and a timesheet CSV. The workflow fills in the actual person-days, calculates plan vs. actual deviations with a traffic light, updates the cumulative sheet, and replies with the updated file.

## Who's it for
Project controllers and project managers who compare planned and booked effort every month.

## How it works
1. Every 5 minutes, Outlook is checked for an unread email with two attachments: the Excel template and the timesheet CSV.
2. The template is uploaded to OneDrive and its structure is read via the Microsoft Graph API.
3. The CSV is parsed and hours are summed per person and month, then converted to person-days (hours / 8).
4. Names are matched against the template and the deviation per person is calculated (green < 5%, yellow < 15%, red from 15%).
5. Actual values and sum formulas are written to the template cell by cell.
6. The cumulative sheet gets a new month column or a corrected one.
7. A summary is sent by email with the updated template. Errors from earlier steps are listed in the email. The original email is marked as read.

## Expected template layout
- Sheet 1: months in the header row, then two rows per person (PLAN, ACTUAL), followed by sum rows
- Sheet 2: cumulative plan and actual per month

## How to set up
1. Connect Outlook and OneDrive credentials with Graph access.
2. Set sheet names, file name keywords, and CSV column names in the configuration.
3. Use the sample template and CSV, then adapt them to your data.

## Requirements
- Microsoft 365 with Outlook and OneDrive
- Excel template in the layout above
- CSV with name, date, and hours columns

## How to customize
Change the thresholds, the hours-per-day value, the language of the email, or the sender allowlist.

Test with dummy data. The CSV contains personal data, so check data protection rules first.
